description.value: Moosehaven Resort is a seasonal lakeside retreat on Hathaway Lake near 100 Mile House, offering heated lakefront cabins with full kitchens and 33 serviced RV sites along popular touring routes toward Banff, Whistler, and Alaska. The resort has operated for over 20 years and is known for its quiet, wildlife-rich setting and explicitly inclusive, everyone-friendly culture. Touring cyclists will find laundry, strong fiber-optic Wi-Fi across the whole property, and on-site kayak and canoe rentals.

address.value: 7563 Pettyjohn Road, Lone Butte, BC, V0K 1X3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides rich detail about Moosehaven Resort. Laundry facilities and superb free Wi-Fi (upgraded to TELUS Fiber-optic) are explicitly confirmed in website text. No mention of bike-specific storage, e-bike charging, or staff bike procedures anywhere on the site, so those remain null. Contact details (phone, address) are sourced from the website's contact page, as OSM carried none.
concerns: OSM tag is tourism=hotel, but the business is a lakeside resort with cabins and RV/camping sites — OSM tag is imprecise though the Accommodation category is correct.
No phone or address in OSM record; both sourced from website contact page.
Secure bike storage not mentioned anywhere on the website — recommend contacting resort directly to confirm before publishing listing.
Seasonal operation (approximately late April to late October); not available year-round.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, actively operating seasonal resort on a key Cariboo touring corridor with cabins, RV sites, laundry, and strong Wi-Fi. Secure bike storage is unconfirmed but the property is clearly suitable for touring cyclists and warrants a directory listing pending direct contact to clarify storage arrangements.
enrichment_extras.notes: One cabin (Cabin 2 – Palace) is explicitly described as wheelchair-friendly with a wide walk-in shower and ramp. The resort enforces a no-dogs policy (certified service dogs excepted). Kayaks and canoes available to rent on-site.
